informational.rule: area "src" write is granted to role dev

cases.name: the only matching area decides
cases.why: With one matching area, that area decides.

informational.rule: area "billing" is writable by role biller only

cases.name: the more specific area denies a member granted only the broader area
cases.why: The area whose pattern has the longer literal prefix wins.

informational.rule: area "billing" write is granted to role biller

cases.name: the more specific area allows a member granted only that area
cases.why: The area whose pattern has the longer literal prefix wins.

informational.rule: area "src" is writable by role dev only

cases.name: a grant on the more specific area does not open the broader area
cases.why: A grant applies only where its area wins.

informational.rule: area "tie-b" is writable by role admin, biller only

cases.name: an exact tie denies when the first area allows and the second denies
cases.why: Between two areas of equal specificity, the one that denies wins.

informational.rule: area "tie-a" is writable by role admin, dev only

cases.name: an exact tie denies when the first area denies and the second allows
cases.why: The tie rule does not depend on the order of the areas.

informational.rule: area "tie-a" write is granted to role admin

cases.name: an exact tie allows when both areas allow, and reports the first area
cases.why: When neither area denies, the area listed first in the bundle is reported.

informational.rule: area "pkg-nested" write is granted to role dev

cases.name: equal prefixes: the pattern with more segments wins and allows
cases.why: When the literal prefixes have the same length, the pattern with more `/`-separated segments wins.

informational.rule: area "pkg-nested" is writable by role dev only

cases.name: equal prefixes: the pattern with more segments wins and denies
cases.why: When the literal prefixes have the same length, the pattern with more `/`-separated segments wins.

informational.rule: area "lib" write is granted to role dev

cases.name: an area competes with its most specific matching pattern
cases.why: Each area is ranked by the best of its patterns that match the path.

informational.rule: area "vendor" is not writable by any role

cases.name: a pattern that does not match the path does not rank its area
cases.why: Only the patterns that match the path count.

informational.rule: area "long-prefix" write is granted to role dev

cases.name: a longer literal prefix wins over more segments
cases.why: The prefix length is compared first. `abc/d**` has the prefix `abc/d` and two segments, and it wins over `abc/*/e`, which has a shorter prefix and three segments.

description: Which area decides when several areas match one path.
